translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: De'uwaa Shuchchaanne Geeshsha Asaa
Hewaa diraw, hintteppe iitatetsaa ubbaa, c'immiyaawaa ubbaa, lo"a malatiyaa iitatetsaa, k'anaatiyaanne zigirssaa ubbaa diggite.
Goday keeka gideeddawaa hintte de'uwaan be'eeddawaa gidooppe, ha"i yeletteedda gac'ino naanatuwaadan, ushiidde dic'c'anawunne attanaw s'illo gideedda ayaanaa maatsaa laamotite.
Godaakko de'o shuchchaakko shiik'ite. Asay Aa is's'eedda; shin S'oossaa matan I dooretteedda al"o.

Hinttekka k'ay de'o shuchchaadan, geeshsha k'eesaa gidiide, Yesuusi Kiristtoosa baggana S'oossaa nashechchiyaa ayaanaa yarshshuwaa S'oossaw yarshshanaw, hintte hintte huup'ew ayaana keetsaadan kees'ettite.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Be'ite, taani S'iyoone giyaa katamaan golliyaa godaa s'ap'uwaa minisiyaa, dooretteedda, al"o shuchchaa wotsay; aan ammaniyaa ooninne yeellatenna» yaagee.

Hewaa diraw, ha shuchchay hinttenttoo ammaniyaawanttoo daro al"a; shin ammanennawanttoo, «Gimbbiyaawanttu kad'eedda shuchchay godaa s'ap'uwaa minisiyaa, ubbaappe aad'd'iyaa shuchchaa gideedda» yaagee.
K'aykka, «Ha shuchchay asaa d'ubbiyaa shuchchaanne asaa kunddissiyaa zaallaa» yaagee; unttunttu S'oossaa k'aalaa ammanenna diraw, unttunttoo kasenna k'ofetteeddawaadan d'ubetteeddino.
Shin S'oossay d'umaappe maalalissiyaa bare poo'oo hinttena s'eeseedda; hintte Aa ooratsa oosuwaa odanaw dooretteedda zare; hintte kaatiyaa k'eesatuwaa; geeshsha asanne S'oossaw buzo asaa.
Hintte kase S'oossaa asaa gidikkita; shin ha"i hintte Aa asaa; hintte kase maarotetsaa akkibeykkita; shin ha"i maarotetsaa akkeeddita.
S'oossaa Ayilatuwaa
Ta dabbatoo, hintte ha sa'aan imatsaanne bete gidiide de'iyaawantta gideeddawaadan, ubbaa wode hintte shemppuwaanna olettiyaa asatetsaa amuwaappe hintte haakkana mala, taani hinttena woossay.

Amanenna Asay hinttena iitabaa ootsiyaawanttudan zigiriyaa wode, Kiristtoosi yiyaa gallassi hintte lo"o oosuwaa unttunttu akeekiide, S'oossaa galatana mala, hintte de'uwaa unttunttu giddon loytsi naagite.
Godaa diraw, asaa higgiyaa ubbaw moodettite; kaatiikka ubbaappe bolla gidiyaa diraw, aw moodettite.
K'ay gadiyaa mooddiyaawanttookka moodettite. Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu iitabaa ootsiyaawantta muranawunne lo"obaa ootsiyaawantta galatanaw kaatiyaappe kiitetteeddino.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay hintte hintte lo"o oosuwaan kad'iyaa eeyaa asatuwaa haasayaa c'o"u udanawaa koyyee.
Ayiletetsaappe kesiide, S'oossaa ayiliyaadan de'iteppe attin, he ayiletetsaappe keseeddawaa iitatetsaa gentsiyaawaa ootsoppite.
Asaa ubbaa bonchchite. Hintte ishatuwaa siik'ite. S'oossaw yayyite. Kaatiyaa bonchchite.
Kiristtoosa Gakkeedda Metuwaa Leemisuwaa
Ayilatoo, hintte lo"o godatuwaa s'alalawunne ashikke godatuwaa s'alalaw gidennaan, iitatookka daro yayyiide moodettite.
Ayaw gooppe, Asay naak'k'iyaa wode waayettiyaa uray S'oossaa k'oppiide, oge baynnaan naak'ettooppe S'oossay Aa anjjana.
Ayaw gooppe, hintte nagaraa ootsina, hinttena dechchiyaa wode, hintte danddayooppe, hinttenttoo ay galatay de'ii? Shin lo"obaa ootsiide waayiyaa hintte danddayooppe, S'oossay hinttena hewoo anjjana.
S'oossay hinttena s'eeseeddawe hewaa diraassa; ayaw gooppe, Kiristtoosi hinttenttoo waayettee; hintte Aa k'atamaa kaallana mala, hinttenttoo leemisuwaa gideedda.
Nagaraa I ootsibeenna; bare doonaappe wordduwaa haasayibeenna.
Asay barena boriyaa wode, zaariide boribeenna; waayettiyaa wodekka manddibeenna. Shin s'illuwaa pirddiyaa S'oossaw barena aatsiide immeedda.
Nuuni nagaraw hayk'k'iide, s'illotetsaw de'ana mala, Kiristtoosi bare huup'ew bare ashuwaan nu nagaraa mask'k'aliyan tookkeedda; hintte Aa maytsaan pas'eeddita.
Ayaw gooppe, hintte ogii baleedda dorssaa mala; shin ha"i hintte shemppuwaa heemmiyaawaakkonne naagiyaawaakko simmeeddita.
